legend: Imagine that your city is an infinite 2D plane with Cartesian coordinate system. The only crime-affected road of your city is the x-axis. Currently, there are n criminals along the road. No police station has been built on this road yet, so the mayor wants to build one.

As you are going to be in charge of this new police station, the mayor has asked you to choose a suitable position (some integer point) for building it. You should choose the best position for the police station, so that you could minimize the total time of your criminal catching mission. Your mission of catching the criminals will operate only from this station.

The new station will have only one patrol car. You will go to the criminals by this car, carry them on the car, bring them back to the police station and put them in prison. The patrol car can carry at most m criminals at a time. Note that, the criminals don't know about your mission. So, they will stay where they are instead of running away.

Your task is to find the position for the police station, so that total distance you need to cover to catch all the criminals will be minimum possible. Note that, you also can built the police station on the positions where one or more criminals already exist. In such a case all these criminals are arrested instantly.
input: The first line of the input will have two integers n (1 ≤ n ≤ 106) and m (1 ≤ m ≤ 106) separated by spaces. The next line will contain n integers separated by spaces. The ith integer is the position of the ith criminal on the x-axis. Absolute value of positions will not exceed 109. If a criminal has position x, he/she is located in the point (x, 0) of the plane.
The positions of the criminals will be given in non-decreasing order. Note, that there can be more than one criminal standing at some point of the plane.
Note: since the size of the input/output could be very large, don't use slow input/output techniques in your language. For example, do not use input/output streams (cin, cout) in C++.
output: Print a single integer, that means the minimum possible distance you need to cover to catch all the criminals.

legend.ai: 想象一下，你的城市是一个带有笛卡尔坐标系的无限二维平面。城市中唯一受犯罪影响的道路是 x 轴。目前，沿着这条道路有 n 名罪犯。由于这条道路上还没有建造警察局，因此市长想要建造一个。
由于你将负责这座新警察局，市长请你选择一个合适的位置（某个整数点）来建造它。你应选择警察局的最佳位置，以使抓捕罪犯任务的总耗时最小。你的抓捕任务只能从这座警察局出发进行。
新警察局只有一辆巡逻车。你将驾驶这辆车前往罪犯所在位置，将他们带上车，带回警察局并关进监狱。巡逻车每次最多可搭载 m 名罪犯。注意，罪犯并不知道你的任务，因此他们会留在原地而不会逃跑。
你的任务是确定警察局的位置，使抓捕全部罪犯所需行驶的总距离尽可能小。注意，你也可以将警察局建在一个或多个罪犯已经所在的位置。在这种情况下，这些罪犯都会被立即逮捕。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含两个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 10^6）和 m（1 ≤ m ≤ 10^6），由空格分隔。下一行包含 n 个由空格分隔的整数。第 i 个整数表示第 i 名罪犯在 x 轴上的位置。位置的绝对值不超过 10^9。如果某名罪犯的位置为 x，则他/她位于平面上的点 (x, 0)。
罪犯的位置将按非递减顺序给出。注意，平面上的同一个点可能站着多名罪犯。
注意：由于输入/输出规模可能非常大，请不要在你所使用的语言中采用速度较慢的输入/输出方式。例如，在 C++ 中不要使用输入/输出流（cin、cout）。

output.ai: 输出一个整数，表示为了抓住所有罪犯需要覆盖的可能最小距离。
